review_summary: Exact pulled library independently reviewed through HID Device send path, callers, consumers, CFI thunks, ordinary memcpy and 4112-byte downstream allocation. Six instructions change report cap, allocation, diagnostics, both advertised MTUs, and peer cap. 74 Unicorn ARM64 behavioral cases and exact ELF/instruction/input-rejection checks passed. Phone stock preflight passed read-only. Android runtime, mount activation and Switch/amiibo not tested.

patches.rationale: Accept reports through 512 bytes; reject 513 and above.
Report the actual limit in the diagnostic.
Shared immediate initializes both control and interrupt MTUs.
Preserve min(peer MTU, local cap) semantics.

device_preflight: stock compatibility and late activation refusal passed; no mount or install performed
